DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Discord application's public verification key (not bot token).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Existing bot token. Enter directly into Cloudflare secrets; never commit it.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated owner Discord IDs. Empty denies all users.

MCP_HOST.description: Exact custom MCP hostname protected by Cloudflare Access. workers.dev and preview URLs stay disabled.

ACCESS_ISSUER.description: Cloudflare Access team issuer, e.g. https://team.cloudflareaccess.com

ACCESS_SUBJECT.description: Authorized owner Access user subject UUID. Not a display name.

SUBSCRIPTION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Optional Events-only secret: 64 hex characters for AES-256-GCM. Enter directly into Worker secrets; requires private SUBSCRIPTIONS R2 binding and activation gates.
